title: Supply Chain Resilience Report: Single-Source Dependency Analysis, Lead-Time Vulnerabilities, Inventory Buffer Assessment, and Supplier Diversification Roadmap
subtitle: Supply Chain Resilience Report — Single-Source Risks, Lead-Time Vulnerabilities, Inventory Buffers & Diversification Roadmap

document_brief.narrative_theme: Quantify and mitigate supply risk by pinpointing single-source and long-lead vulnerabilities, validating inventory buffers against disruption scenarios, and executing a time-phased supplier diversification roadmap to protect service levels and revenue.
